reading: This is a movie poster/hero design: a large tilted repeating-stripe background panel, a soft blurred oval glow behind the title, a huge two-line italic title 'The Long Night' (with 'Night' in raspberry), a block of five credit lines (film-by line, Starring, two cast names, In cinemas), a printer's registration-mark crosshair graphic, a solid raspberry 'WATCH TRAILER' button, and a tilted 'OFFICIAL SELECTION VENEZIA' badge.
